**8.** (a) Chance quality, body part, and play pattern; each varies across forwards' shot diets (associated with which forward is shooting) and shifts scoring probability (associated with whether the shot is scored). (b) Answers vary; key: defensive pressure and opposition/goalkeeper quality — both differ across forwards' contexts and affect conversion. (c) Because raw conversion reflects the mix of chances as much as finishing skill; without the breakdown, differences between forwards may be entirely due to the confounders rather than finishing ability.

**10.** (a) More attack-minded; its most defense-minded members left. (b) More attack-minded; the signings are more attack-minded than the incumbent defensive-unit players. (c) More defense-minded; the players brought in are more defense-minded than the attackers they replaced. (d) Report unit-by-unit (more attack-minded) when the units are assessed or managed separately; report the aggregate (more defense-minded) when assessing the squad's overall profile — Simpson's paradox: the two levels legitimately disagree.
